{{Top}}
[[File:C-3PO_oil_bath.png|thumb|right|300px|Luke Skywalker gives C-3PO an oil bath]]
{{Quote|Thank the maker! This oil bath is going to feel so good. I've got such a bad case of dust contamination, I can barely move!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|audio=OilBath.flac|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Oil baths''', also known as '''lubrication baths''', were a means of removing such things as dust, dirt, and various other forms of matter that collected in a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] joints and sockets, similar to a regular water bath for [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Without treatment, the debris could cause the joints to become difficult to move or lock up altogether, a condition known as [[Dust contamination/Legends|dust contamination]].

==History==
{{Quote|Did you hear something go ''<nowiki>'clank'</nowiki>'' a moment ago?"<br />"It was probably just my rusty ''knee'' joints."<br />"You too? I thought I was the ''only one'' who suffered from ''metal fatigue''."<br />"Maybe it's because we're exposed to the ''elements''.|Two B1-Series battle droids|<ref name="tot">{{TCWComicCite|6.5|Terror on the Twilight|Terror on the ''Twilight''}}</ref>}}
[[File:3PO_TCG_by_Juta.jpg|thumb|left|180px|C-3PO emerging from an oil bath.]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] enjoyed an oil bath on [[Droid Spa/Legends|Coruscant droid spa]].

The [[Great Heep]] was known to provide such a cleansing, along with other pleasantries, to unassuming droids before consuming them.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] treated [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to an oil bath on the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars moisture farm]] after his uncle [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] purchased the droid from [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit's]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] tribe, which delighted him. Due to his [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], however, C-3PO was unaware that he had been similarly given an oil bath by a restless [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in the Lars garage when she needed a task to take her mind off [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin's]] [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|rescue]] of his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|mother]]. The bathing session had been much-needed, as the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] had extensive amounts of sand and dirt lodged in his coverings.
